Sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate, and magnesium sulfate increase the toxicity of fludrocortisone through mechanisms related to fluid and electrolyte abnormalities. Use caution and monitor the patient closely. Co-administration with medications that cause fluid and electrolyte imbalances may increase the risk of adverse events such as seizures, arrhythmias, and renal impairment. 8. Sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate, and magnesium sulfate enhance the effects of fluoxetine through an unknown mechanism. Use caution and monitor the patient closely. Be vigilant for signs of seizures when bowel preparations are used in combination with drugs that lower the seizure threshold. 9.
